Single or Double Battle challenges with rental homies.Once you in, the run keep goin'

get Battle Points (BP).If you wanna dip mid-run,
save the game first.If you don't save, you
gettin' disqualified. No cap.Don't say I ain't warn you!

Multi Battle challenge with rental homies.Both partners get two rental
homies each.Once you in, you and your partner

rentals that only know weak moves.Open Level let you rent
Lv. 100 homies with heavy moves right from the jump.Heads up: a Battle Factory Multi
Battle run can't get paused.
